name: EnZIME Aurora Glass
rules: Use glass only for chrome and overlays, never behind long-form article text.
Use periwinkle for primary action and navigation.
Use teal for verified, ready, active, or connected state.
Show status with icon and text; never rely on color alone.
Keep the reader surface opaque, quiet, and typographically editorial.
Use compact JetBrains Mono telemetry for sizes, versions, hashes, and readiness.
Every primary action has a visible keyboard focus state.
Support 200 percent text scaling without clipped controls.
Eliminate nonessential motion in reduced-motion mode.
Do not rename any component or entity supplied in a screen prompt.
